title: Territory and zoom-level data model
description: A territory is a record: its bounds (what it covers), its zoom level, its summary statistics, its neighbors, and the rule that generated it from the level below. Zoom levels are fixed and named — field, record, collection, domain, discipline — so maps from different runs are comparable.
